sources.snippet: Overview facial_emotions_image_detection is an image classification model that detects one of seven facial emotions—sad, disgust, angry, neutral, fear, surprise, and happy—from facial images with 91% overall accuracy. sources.snippet: Detect faces, bounding boxes, and five facial landmarks (eyes, nose, mouth corners) in any image via a simple REST API. Upload a JPEG or PNG, get structured JSON back. 5,000 free requests/month.

sources.title: facial_emotions_image_detection | AI Model Details
sources.snippet: The facial_emotions_image_detection model, created by maintainer dima806, is an AI model that can detect human facial emotions based on an input image. This model is similar to other facial emotion recognition models like face_emotion_recognition and emotion_text_classifier, which aim to classify emotions from either images or text data.
